notes.title: Patch Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
Version 1.1.0 Miso now live!
Things have been stable so I've pushed a few new features along with bug fixes and feedback as a thank you to everyone for making this game launch so smooth!

A Secret location has been added to the Island map once a restaurant reaches four Hoku.
[list]
[*] What does it do?  It's secret!
[*] A new achievement has been added to match.  It's a secret!
[/list]
A new S level support has been added for Pele and Hina.
[list]
[*] New epilogue text and pixel polaroid added to match.
[*] A new achievement has been added to match.  This one is not secret :P
[/list]
Dialogue scene upgrades.
[list]
[*] Autoplay has now been added.
[*] The dialogue scene now has a settings pane.  Tune your text speeds, text sfx, and autoplay speeds to your liking!
[/list]
Sound settings
[list]
[*] The master volume toggle has been swapped out for an SFX toggle.  It'll start at a default, so please change it to what you'd like!  It was a weird situation before where BGM was being double affected by the master volume while SFX weren't, so no more of that :P
[*] Settings are now saved to disk instead of the registry.  Solves an issue where settings wouldn't be saved sometimes due to Antivirus or OS settings.
[/list]
Other
[list]
[*] Mall (Crisis) open service ticket count has been reduced (config issue was causing more tough customer tickets than intended)
[*] Fixed an issue with Quality score calculations ignoring flavor trends
[*] Various UI improvements around the game including easier twist management, sorted skill books (with viewable "in use" books toggleable), an 'owned count' view in the shop.
[*] Various other bug fixes and typos.  Thank you for your reports!
[/list]

Thanks for playing!
-Lemonpepper Fine

notes.title: Patch Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
1.0.4
Thank you all for such a positive launch so far.  I'm so excited to see so many people enjoying the game and letting me know when they find issues!  This patch hopefully takes care of many of the reported issues so far, and brings a few small goodies as well.

Six new achievements have been added
[list]
[*] Four new achievements related to story check points.  If you already passed the point in the story where you'd earn these, you'll unlock them the next time you complete a day.
[*]One new achievement for recruiting chefs.  If you already have the required number of chefs, you'll unlock this after viewing any dialogue scene.
[*] One new achievement for viewing a support conversation for the first time.  If you have already seen one, this will trigger the next time you watch a support convo
[/list]

The dialogue skip controls have been improved.  While fast forwarding, the standard nav controls are replaced by a pause button that won't disappear when dialogue is hidden during scenes.

Several bug fixes to reported issues.  Thank you for your bug reports!
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare soft lock during the first chapter that could prevent missions from opening
[*] Fixed a rare soft lock in the kitchen caused by quickly grabbing destroyed dishes
[*] Fixed the Level 10 and Level 20 achievement to correct check for chef counts
[*] Fixed several controller layering issues
[*] Share Speed etc cookbooks have had their descriptions corrected and now correctly increase in effectiveness from Kala/Kai's Fast Learner ability
[*] Several other fixes across the game!
[/list]

Thanks for playing!
-Lemonpepper Fine

notes.title: Kitchen Sync: Aloha! is on Steamdeck!
notes.content:
Happy New Years!  Lots of changes have been heading to Kitchen Sync: Aloha! behind the scenes and some are finally ready to share.  A new update (0.6.1f) is now available for the free Steam Demo, and the biggest change I wanted to highlight is Steam Deck support!  This has been a popular request so I wanted to make sure to take the time to get it to a quality level I was happy with.  My goal was to be not just compatible with steam deck, but great on it!

The game is designed to be played in fullscreen mode on the Deck (you can choose this from the settings menu if Steam doesn't launch you into fullscreen on its own).  KS:A! now has full controller support, so the entirety of the game can be played with the controller.  Button hints will show up using the XBox controller mapping that the Valve steam deck also shares.

I've put in several weeks of testing on my own Steam Deck (the 512GB non-OLED) and am pretty happy with the experience, but as usual would love to hear any feedback or bugs so I can keep making improvements.  Looking forward to hearing from you and sharing some big news early this year!

This update also revamps the game economy and level up system, as well as fixing some bugs, adjusting some game balance, and brining general support for xbox controllers.  As usual, if you're looking for weekly updates or to chat/share feedback consider joining our discord!

Thanks!
--Lemonpepper Fine

notes.title: [Demo Update] Bug Fixes and Quality of Life Improvements
notes.content:
Small Update to the Demo with some bug fixes and quality of life improvements.  Thank you to everyone who's tried the demo, and extra thanks to those who've reported bugs and feedback.  Mahalo!

- UI
[list]
[*]Added 'Idle' reminder above pause button to increase clarity
[*]Hovering over a stat in the level up screen shows explanation of the stat
[*]The screen dims behind the sync bar for a moment when it fully charges
[/list]
- Cooking
[list]
[*]Ensured Autopause kicks in for a range of corner cases like gifts disappearing and dishes being lifted during cooking
[*]Fixed a physics bug allowing chefs with multiple move speed buffs to overshoot their targets or clip through scenery
[/list]
- Tooltips
[list]
[*]Properly scale with screen size
[*]A tooltip now shows up in Lv1 explaining that chefs can be right clicked to view info
[*]Help text appears when you try to serve an unfinished dish
[/list]
- Game Balance
[list]
[*]Tutorial gift appears a bit later to avoid conflict with the sync style tutorial
[*]Uncle's ability tweaked to partially fill the sync bar at the start of the level instead of just multiplying the incoming sync amounts
[*]Reduced ticket difficulty for early chapters/missions
[*]Increased time limits for early chapters/missions
[/list]
- SFX
[list]
[*]Initial volume settings during first run should be reduced
[*]Tickets will play sfx when ready
[*]Autopause now plays sfx when pausing
[/list]
- Twists
[list]
[*]Bad Twists cannot be discovered anymore (they're removed from the game for now!)
[*]Mastery effects on dish starting quality have been increased to compensate!
[*]Assisted Twists are now flagged as such immediately.  No need for guess and check!
[*]The Skill Experimenter now triggers if you've discovered a perfect twist instead of a bad twist
[/list]
- Customizer
[list]
[*]Autofill now prefers special stations to normal stations.  Still random between types of special stations.
[*]Auto filling stations now correctly clears current stations to make room for new needed ones.  Currently reshuffles station placement as well, might revisit someday.
[*]A trendy tag now shows up for trending flavored dishes (just for more clarity!)
[/list]
- Misc other bugs and improvements!

notes.title: KS:A! Development Update - Valentines Edition!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Aloha![/b][/h1]

Kitchen Sync: Aloha!'s development has been continuing along over here at Lemonpepper HQ.  We've gone a bit without a steam post, so I wanted to share some updates here!  In particular, it's valentines day so let's talk character relationships!

[h2][b]Support Bonds[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43723391/3e43761fb7d51aace35b003395e210d596c1bdbe.png[/img]

As your chefs cook together, cooperation will start to make them more than coworkers.  This is not limited to the main character - whichever chefs you decide to pair for a shift will start gaining support bonds with each other.  As their bond deepens, those chefs may have special support conversation scenes that help them grow closer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43723391/efe3ba1e4c0650fd36cb3a60e87526dad21384c0.png[/img]

Different chefs have different levels of compatibility, but every chef has several close relationships to develop.  These relationships are graded C, B, and A as chefs grow tighter.  A few pairs can even reach the final S level - a once-per-character decision that links two chefs together romantically.  Juicy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43723391/a75428781af8e5777ce08e44137ced8226112886.png[/img]

[h2][b]What's Love got to do with it?[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43723391/8072569ad38f57d37ceff1bd281bdabd6dcf448a.png[/img]
Support Bonds have significant rewards for gameplay.  At the most basic level, each support conversation gives a small, permanent stat boost - but there's a lot more.  As chefs gain support levels they become more invested in your team and your restaurant.  They may help out with discovering new Twists, offer to share new recipes, help share local gossip or ingredients, or more!

[h2][b]Schedule[/b][/h2]
Our plan remains to launch into early access (if needed) and then full release this year.  Before that though, look forward to a new demo (soon!) that has many of these support features for you to try out yourself.

If you prefer more frequent news, join us on the Lemonpepper [url=https://discord.gg/xTd9CHWSAu]discord [/url]to get weekly updates, sneak peaks, and even join our playtesting community.

Mahalo!
Lemonpepper Games//Matt
